steps.text: Confirm the alarm activation ceases within the announced ~90-second test window.
Verify main_stage and entrance sensor readings remain nominal (smoke_ppm=0, temp_c=21) with no new anomalies.
Check for any staff or tenant reports of smoke, fire, or distress; if none, close out the incident as a confirmed drill.
If the alarm persists beyond the test window or any sensor anomaly appears, reclassify and escalate per protocol.
